nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file enumerating backend configuration variables: Postgres/Redis connection strings, OpenRouter API key and model slugs for chat/embedding/reranking, JWT signing secret, PaddleOCR microservice settings, and rerank scoring knobs.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Guidance file for Claude Code covering the project's stack, npm/lint commands, ESLint rules, frontend architecture, and the agentic LangGraph RAG backend pipeline (entry point, status-field convention, eval harness, and reingestion workflow).

nodes.name: DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Apple-inspired visual design system specification covering color palette, typography scale, component styling, spacing, elevation, and responsive rules, including an agent prompt guide for generating UI components consistent with the style.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Default create-vite README describing the React + Vite scaffold, the available official Vite React plugins, and pointers for enabling the React Compiler or TypeScript/type-aware ESLint.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML shell for the Vite single-page app; defines the root mount div and loads the React entry module via a module script tag.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the frontend defining Vite dev/build/lint/preview scripts and pinning React 19.2, react-router-dom 7, and the ESLint 9 flat-config toolchain as dependencies.

nodes.name: prompt.md
nodes.summary: Short scratch note instructing implementation of a Figma-designed chat UI reachable from the home page.
